JNVST, CHS and BHU Entrance Exam Preparation in Handia

Athak Prayas Academy provides preparation for the Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya Selection Test (JNVST), CHS and BHU entrance examinations. Students and parents can contact the academy to confirm the current courses, class eligibility, schedule and fees.

Exams covered

  • JNVST: Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya Selection Test preparation
  • CHS: Central Hindu School entrance preparation
  • BHU: BHU entrance exam preparation

Exam formats, eligibility and important dates can change. Please check the latest official notice from the relevant exam authority. Athak Prayas Academy is an independent coaching academy and is not affiliated with these institutions or exam bodies.
